latestVersion.changelog:
Exfer 1.1.0 expands the RPC reference and drops a discontinued service section.                                                                                          
   
  - Added `get_script_utxos` to the RPC methods table — returns the spendable UTXO list locked to an exact output script (max 1,000). Available in node binary v1.9.0+.    
  - Removed section 9 "Task Server (Earn EXFER)". The centralized HTLC-bounty service it described is no longer operating; agents should not call its endpoints.
  - No breaking changes to wallet, mining, send-payment, HTLC, covenant, or core RPC flows.
